name: Tamara Hope
biography: Tamara Hope (born November 2, 1984) is a Canadian actress. Her starring roles include Guinevere Jones and The Nickel Children, a film about teenage prostitution. Tamara had a recurring role on CTV's now defunct Whistler as Leah McLure. Hope has recently been featured in the Modernista! ad campaign promoting the Palm Pre phone.
